connector.name: Imgx
connector.registryDescription: AI image generation and editing MCP server. Gemini + OpenAI, iterative editing, undo/redo.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package imgx-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the somacoffeekyoto account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. Optional if configured via 'imgx config set api-key'.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key. Optional if configured via 'imgx config set api-key --provider openai'.
